scientific_integrity: The objective and qualitative SPD warning are acknowledged as prior work. The exact frontier, minimal-dimension result, and constrained cost are the evaluated contribution.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional SPD matrices; diagonal support only; no claim about DG element realizability.
Analytic sign criterion is general in dimension three; exact cone-penalty formula only for the symmetric-coupling subfamily.
Strictly positive diagonal feasible region has an unattained infimum in the sign-loss window; the PSD cone optimum is singular.
No guarantee for sparse non-diagonal patterns, iterative approximate fit, numerical rounding or full multigrid convergence.
Historical-priority and independent mathematical validation are incomplete.
title: Sharp positivity frontier for energy-scaled diagonal inverse fitting in dimension three
